actions.findings:
AI training recommendation dependence is positively associated with body signal outsourcing. [source-43e60aa546c849b2]

Body signal outsourcing leads to reduced self-regulation, increased training decision hesitation, and reduced training self-efficacy in a serial pathway. [source-43e60aa546c849b2]
actions.limitations: Current findings are based on cross-sectional data; the proposed serial association requires longitudinal validation to confirm causal directionality.

actions.summary: Evidence indicates that AI training recommendation dependence functions as a serial mediator in reducing athlete training self-efficacy. actions.title: AI Dependency and Reduced Autonomy in Athletes

proposal.summary: Updated findings regarding the serial association between AI training recommendation dependence, body signal outsourcing, self-regulation, and training self-efficacy in athletes.
